method: ControlsProbe constructs GameSettings headlessly and calls KeyBinding.setKeyBindState/onTick/isPressed/getIsKeyPressed, GameSettings.setOptionKeyBinding, setOptionValue(RENDER_DISTANCE), setOptionFloatValue(FRAMERATE_LIMIT), saveOptions and loadOptions, and LWJGL Keyboard.getKeyName/getKeyIndex. Layout constants and the runTick key table are javap-read and asserted above.

resetAll.enabled: any key code differs from its default
resetAll.action: setKeyCode(default) for every binding then resetKeyBindingArrayAndHash; no saveOptions

keyEntry.conflict: §c<name> when keyCode != 0 and another binding has the same code

editing.mouse: mouseClicked while a binding is selected: setOptionKeyBinding(binding, -100 + button)
editing.key: keyTyped: Escape (1) binds 0 (NONE), any other key binds its code; time stored for the 20 ms dispatchKeypresses guard

whenNoScreen.61: F3 showDebugInfo toggle on key down; showDebugProfilerChart = shift held
whenNoScreen.61+33: F3+F setOptionValue(RENDER_DISTANCE, shift ? -1 : 1) (no RENDER_DISTANCE branch in 1.7.10, so only saveOptions)
whenNoScreen.61+46: F3+C held 6000 ms: manually triggered debug crash

always.62: F4 entityRenderer.deactivateShader (also with a screen open)
always.key.streamStartStop: dispatchKeypresses: stop, confirm start, GuiStreamUnavailable or "Not ready to start streaming yet!"
always.key.streamToggleMic: mic toggle on press and release

afterEvents: key.chat isPressed and chat not hidden: GuiChat
key.command isPressed, no screen, chat not hidden: GuiChat("/")
key.use held while using an item; key.attack / key.use / key.pickItem isPressed: click actions
key.use held: rightClickMouse repeat when rightClickDelayTimer is 0
key.attack held with no screen: sendClickBlockToController
runTick.framerate: runGameLoop: Display.sync(getLimitFramerate()) when getLimitFramerate() < FRAMERATE_LIMIT max (260); getLimitFramerate is 30 with no world and a screen open, else GameSettings.limitFramerate
runTick.hideGUI: EntityRenderer: GuiIngame is drawn when !hideGUI or a screen is open; renderHand, the selection outline (in and out of water) skip while hideGUI
